name: perler-beads-generator
description: Browser-based Perler bead pattern editor: turn photos into bead charts with real MARD / Artkal color codes, edit layer by layer, preview in 3D, and export printable charts and usage lists — all processed locally.

scripts.build: tsc && node scripts/clean-dist.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/post-build.cjs && node scripts/write-html.cjs
